desc:
🏨 Welcome to the ultimate Hotel roleplay experience!
Become a Receptionist, Lifeguard, Chef, Room Service, or a Hotel guest exploring the hotel. Check guests in, rescue guests, clean rooms, and experience world class luxury. Whether you want to work a full shift or just hang out and roleplay, there's always something happening at the Hotel.
Customize your character, unlock new jobs, and discover secrets around the Hotel. Start your shift and let your adventure take off!

💼 Ever wanted to pave your own way? Work as a Receptionist, be a Lifeguard, or Manage the Hotel! Which will you pick? 

🌊 Join our group to gain access to free roles! https://www.roblox.com/groups/4595505/Blau-Hotels-Resorts#!/about

❗Don’t miss out on exclusive updates and perks—be part of our growing community today!
Blau Hotel Luxury Simulator RP
